messages:
ivy: Request from two EMEA customers: allow scheduled region-optin windows that prefer a cheaper quantized model for non-peak workloads. They want a strict rollback ladder and telemetry hooks before sign-up.
san: We can do scheduled opt-in per tenant. Important: make it explicit in Console and require tenant admin consent with timestamped audit.
oscar: From runtime: propose tenant buckets (tiny/small/large) to pick ramp cadence. Tiny -> 1% increments daily; Large -> 0.5/5/25/100 over hours. Each step gated by signals.
neha: Signals: p95 delta < +20% AND error-rate delta < +0.3% AND customer-eval divergence < 1.0% on the assigned prompt set. Any single violation -> immediate rollback for that tenant and an auto-notify to CS.
ivy: Rollback ladder: 1) flip tenant schedule off, 2) set force_pinned_variant=true, 3) if multiple tenants fail -> route all scheduled opt-in traffic to premium pool, 4) open incident if systemic.
oscar: Circuit-breaker: if eu-gpu-util > 80% for 4m OR router-queue-latency > 200ms for 3m -> halt all warmups and divert. Implement in router service.
san: Console UX: schedule editor + preview 예상 savings + required checkbox: "I accept possible small quality variance during scheduled windows". Also show history + emergency contact.
ops-bot: scheduled: optin-staging-probe -> duration 48h -> initiated by oscar.
neha: Small tenants note: require at least 24h of live observation before full 100% cutover. Add a "stability pending" status in UI.
oscar: Owners: Oscar -> router + circuit-breaker, Neha -> eval harness + gating thresholds, San -> Console + audit, Ivy -> product signoff and customer comm.
ivy: Action items and due dates: Console mock by Tue, router hooks by Wed, eval prompt sets by Thu, runbook + notification templates by Fri. If no objections, start staging probe next week. :thumbsup:
san: No objections.
neha: lgtm.
oscar: ready.
